title: ever IVYROSE|Ruffles Sleeve A-Line Chiffon Waist Applique Maxi Mother of the Bride Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant maxi dress is a perfect choice for the mother of the bride or any formal occasion. Featuring ruffled sleeves, a flattering A-line silhouette, and delicate waist applique details, this dress combines sophistication with comfort. The chiffon fabric drapes beautifully, creating a graceful, timeless look.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
